goal: Set up a review queue for human labeling of agent replies for safety, citation, and tone.

expected_steps.interaction: input form (Aria needs information): enter name, description, reviewers and questions from review-queues/agent-reply-review.queue.json, then Approve

input form: enter trace_ids (and optionally assigned_to) from enqueue.json; queue_id is wired from review_queue.create and is not asked for. Then Approve, or Skip step / Deny if you have no traces yet

notes: Both steps come from the one domain word 'review queue'. add_items depends on create (its queue_id input is {$from_step, path: queue_id}). Under autonomy=ask_each every step raises an input form and then an Approve/Deny prompt; under approve_plan and auto_guarded only the input forms appear.
